purpose: Ordered real LiDAR-pose/raw-IMU replay with explicit oldest-state marginalization and LiDAR fallback across rejected IMU edges; no frontend feedback, calibrated covariance, GPU or real-time speed claim
initialization: Gravity from same causal first raw Euler sample as pilot. Segment starts from first two available LiDAR-derived IMU-origin positions, using backward difference for both initial velocities. Zero bias at each segment start. Later initial velocity uses current/previous LiDAR IMU-origin positions; bias is previous estimated latest bias. No later LiDAR pose or ground truth used in an update.
measurement_model: Same fixed diagnostic IMU, random-walk, full-state and pose-prior weights as original pilot settings(). New edges integrated at previous latest estimated bias. No automatic reintegration of old edges.
window_policy: Startup at 2 states. Append state/one new edge/one new pose prior. When full, marginalize only oldest-state incident factors, preserving dense frozen 15D prior. No repeated full-state reset inside a valid run.
gap_policy: Original raw gap >.05 s rejects edge. Clear all inertial window information and emit current LiDAR observation; next valid edge starts a new independent segment. Never integrate or carry inertial certainty through missing readings.
output_policy: Emit latest body pose once per scan; do not retroactively replace published poses when past states are smoothed. First scan and each rejected-gap edge endpoint are explicitly LiDAR-only fallback.

evaluation.primary: Consecutive SE3 RPE translation and rotation RMSE over ALL 472 input scan edges including gap/startup transitions, compared to identical frozen actual LiDAR baseline.
evaluation.secondary: Global per-session SE3 position-aligned ATE, no scale; report RPE separately for valid-IMU and gap edges, all 474 poses covered.
evaluation.reference: Original body raw CSV rows, body-z-up conversion only, xyz interpolation + SO3 SLERP, both reference brackets <=.05 s; no extrapolation.
evaluation.frozen: Estimation for both sessions completed/frozen before separate evaluator reads ground truth.
evaluation.adoption: Do not enable production default. Assess full-trajectory metrics in both sessions, nonconvergence, boundary errors, and independent validation; never replace unsuccessful data with retuned scores.
